program: NFL-004 (TD model), NFL World Model V2
whyThisExists: The published anytime-TD model (P301 opportunityTd) gives a player his overall carry and target shares of the team's TD expectation, scaled by his own shrunk TD rate per touch. Goal-line role enters only through that rate. Its forward test sits at level 1.104 (bar [0.90, 1.10]) and its top bins over-predict (P301: 0.543 predicted vs 0.444 actual; forward 0.83 -> 0.53). NFL-004's ladder step after a hierarchical Bernoulli baseline is 'team scoring opportunities -> red-zone/goal-line role'. This registers that step: TD share from inside-the-N carries and targets (play-by-play), shrunk toward the overall share, with the same active-set reallocation NFL-003 registers.
evidenceTier: SECOND_LOOK_DEVELOPMENT. 2014-2021 was scored blind once by P301 and the author has read its aggregate figures. Outcome on 2014-2021 is only PROCEED_TO_FORWARD or DO_NOT_PROCEED; eligibility comes only from the blind 2026 forward test.
whatTheAuthorHasSeenBeforeRegistering: P301's receipt aggregates (opportunityTd 0.50435 log loss, ECE 0.0203, level 1.035; reliability top bin 0.543 vs 0.444) and the 2026 ATD forward receipt through Week 4.
The red-zone table's join statistics (99.8% of touched player-games join; carries exact 98.6%, targets exact 99.9%). No candidate number.

data.redZone: data/internal/research/nfl/replay/player-redzone-v1.json.gz built by scripts/research/nfl/build-player-redzone-v1.mjs from nflverse play-by-play 2013-2025 (both shas pinned)

engine: scripts/research/nfl/replay-redzone-td.mjs — a fork of P301's replay-anytime-td.mjs with the same walk-forward, gate, team TD form, league constants, clip and metrics; the incumbent opportunityTd is recomputed in the same run.
population: EXACTLY P301's scored rows (no-pull carry share >= 0.05 or target share >= 0.05, a row in the game, not UNKNOWN). The candidate applies no gate of its own.

incumbent.implementationCheck: must reproduce P301's held-out log loss 0.50435 within 1e-4, else the run refuses

rzTdV1.definition: mu = rzCarryShare' * lambdaRush + rzTargetShare' * lambdaRec + otherTdPerPlayerGame; P = 1 - exp(-mu), clipped as P301. lambdaRush/lambdaRec = P301's team TD form. rzCarryShare = (sum_j w_j * c_N,ij + k * carryShare_i) / (sum_j w_j * C_N,j + k) over the player's games at this team (w = P301's share weights; c_N,ij his inside-N carries in game j; C_N,j the team's inside-N carries in game j); rzTargetShare likewise with targets. Primes denote the NFL-003 active-set reallocation (vacated inside-N share redistributed with rho, remainder to OTHER, named sum capped at 1 - 0.02).
rzTdV1.selection: The (insideN, k, rho) with the lowest dev (2022-2025) log loss.

ablations_reportedNotPromotable.opportunityTdRealloc: the incumbent with the active-set reallocation of its overall shares

proceedToForward: rzTdV1 log loss below the incumbent's overall and in both eras
season-bootstrap (2,000 resamples, seed 20261010) 95% upper bound of the paired per-row log-loss difference < 0
ECE <= 0.03 overall and <= 0.04 per era (P301's bars)
level within [0.92, 1.08] overall and per era
top predicted decile: |mean predicted - actual rate| no larger than the incumbent's (reported for both)
frozenBars.outcome: PROCEED_TO_FORWARD when every bar passes; otherwise DO_NOT_PROCEED. Nothing public changes either way.

forwardTest: Blind 2026 forward from Week 6 under the existing ATD forward protocol (anytime-td-forward-protocol.json bars: ECE <= 0.04, level [0.90, 1.10], n >= 1000), captured pre-kickoff with pregame availability as the active set. The capture tool is a separate step.
whatIsNotAllowed: Changing grids, bars, the population rule or the primary candidate after this file is committed.
Any same-game input other than the declared active-set membership; any market price.
